scope: Paths in Git-tracked source files; paths, current builder name and email in explicit artifacts and every file of a publication tree
email_text_class: Complete UTF-8 text (printable Unicode plus TAB/CR/LF), or complete NUL-delimited spans with that property; the same class in decoded UTF-16 and base64 views. Not arbitrary byte substrings.
unidentified_linked_bytes: No foreign exemption: the entire build-derived image remains in the lexical domain.
